text:
maria: Hey team — I'm preparing a tiny refresh for the Mobile Starter quickstart (Android + iOS auth flow). Found a couple of issues in the current snippets: hardcoded API key in samples, no note about redirect URIs, and the Android manifest example uses an old intent-filter. Planning a small PR to fix snippets + add a short troubleshooting section. Anyone want to pair on a final pass?
aj: I can take the PR and run the samples locally. I pushed a draft branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482-mobile-auth-cleanup (WIP). Removed hardcoded key, switched to using env var + instructions for secure storage.
kyle: Quick heads-up — please include a one-line note about embedding the token in logs (don't do it) and an example for adding the redirect to Info.plist for iOS. That bit trips people up.
maria: Good call. I'll add the Info.plist snippet. Also want to switch Android sample to the modern AppAuth flow instead of the custom scheme example.
aj: Landing snippets I tested:
```kotlin
// use SessionManager.getToken() not a compile-time key
val token = SessionManager.instance.getToken(context)
val client = RedwoodClient.Builder().setAuthToken(token).build()
```
Change note: replace README code block that used `val API_KEY = "xxx"` with the above.
sam: I'll do a language/style pass once the code is in. Can we also add a short note on migrating from SDK v4 -> v6? People keep opening issues. Maybe a 2-line migration hint with link to changelog.
maria: Yes — add a small subheading "Migrating from SDK v4" with steps: update dependency, replace client constructor, and confirm token retrieval API. Link to changelog.
aj: Also fixed a broken link in the quickstart (the deep-link troubleshooting doc). PR now includes redirect URI guidance, Info.plist example, and a short migration note. Running CI now.
docs-bot: PR #482 — checks started: markdown-lint, link-check, sample-runner.
kyle: For the Info.plist snippet, use this: 
```xml
<key>CFBundleURLTypes</key>
<array>
  <dict>
    <key>CFBundleURLSchemes</key>
    <array>
      <string>com.redwood.starter</string>
    </array>
  </dict>
</array>
```
Note: use your app's bundle id, don't copy blindly.
sam: Left a couple of copy edits on the PR: reworded the 'store token on disk' paragraph to be clearer and added :no_entry_sign: callouts for insecure practices.
aj: CI green for sample-runner, link-check failed once (old redirects) — fixed another redirect in a separate commit. markdown-lint flagged a line length on Android README, trimmed a sentence.
docs-bot: PR #482 — link-check passed. markdown-lint passed. sample-runner: success.
maria: Amazing — thanks everyone. Can we merge after you (sam) approve? I'd like this in the next docs patch release. :thumbsup:
sam: I'll give it a final thumbs in ~30m after verifying the iOS snippet renders correctly in the site preview.
aj: After merge I'll tag the release branch and add a short release note in CHANGELOG.md: "mobile quickstart: auth snippet cleanup, redirect URI notes, v4->v6 migration hint".
maria: Perfect. If anyone sees follow-up issues, we can follow up with a small FAQ entry. Closing loop here — thanks :smile:
